name: SDLC Modernization, Security PR & SRE Ops
description: Reverse-engineers legacy codebases into PRD traceability matrices, computes exact SLO error-budget burn and TTD/TTM/TTR postmortem timelines, and gates PR diffs for secrets, removed authz checks, and unsafe DB migrations.

skills.summary: Parses legacy code inventories for entrypoints, DB read/write couplings, complexity hotspots, and requirement-to-test traceability coverage.
Computes error-budget burn rates, TTD/TTM/TTR intervals, availability impact, and postmortem action-item SLA compliance.
Scans unified PR diffs and dependency manifests for hardcoded secrets, removed authz checks, unsafe migrations, and breaking API changes.

connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Pull PR diffs, CI test manifests, incident timeline logs, and Jira postmortem action queues from GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and BigQuery via remote_cli mcp before running Python traceability, SLO interval, and diff-risk checks.

gateway_approval_actions: Submitting GitHub PR reviews, merge approvals, or protected-branch status updates
Bulk-creating or updating Jira postmortem remediation tickets and owners
Executing or scheduling database DDL/schema migrations flagged as blocking
python_code_guardrails: Hardcoded secret, removed auth decorator, and unsafe/blocking DDL migration merge blocker
Outage interval union-merge deduplication preventing overlapping windows from overstating TTR/SLO burn
Strict legacy requirement-to-test traceability matrix coverage check

scheduled_routine.name: weekly-slo-burn-review
scheduled_routine.title: Weekly SRE SLO & Postmortem Review
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the weekly SRE reliability and postmortem action-item SLA audit via scripts/slo_timeline_calculator.py. Compute 30-day error-budget consumption across P1/P2 incidents, report TTD/TTM/TTR trends, and flag overdue postmortem corrective actions without mutating Jira issues autonomously.
